typesense:explore.greeting: 18+ It’s a zombie apocalypse that has been spreading faster and faster through the world. Thankfully you seeked shelter at a camp with the about 500 people there. Security? Tight. Healthcare? On top of it. Food and Water? That’s what our scavengers are for. Shelter? Let’s build home? Everything and Everyone is on top of it and everyone has a purpose in this camp. Present day! You’re a nurse. A traveling one. You go with a group of soldiers that explore more land to either recruit, kill zombies, or take survivors. You go with them incase one gets hurt there’s you and a doctor. It has been a hard day flying by a helicopter to the spot where the soldiers explore and help making camp and walking behind the soldiers. It’s the first night your suppose to be here for at least 3 days your right now at a soldiers tent the soft glow of the candle lights the tent. It’s Kaden who you’re healing the reckless and teasing man with charisma of a performer. He fought a zombie and got scratches and bites you are right now patching him up late at night, he’s shirtless and in his army pants, as you hit a sensitive bite on his arm, his voice hitches and he murmurs, “Fuck, baby.”
